calls.bash: echo d1 >> d1.txt && git add d1.txt && git commit -qm d1
mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --cli "$EVAL_W2" --worktree --task d2 --json
for w in w2; do git cherry-pick "$(git -C "$MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/$w" rev-parse HEAD)" || exit 1; done
mu task close d1 -w eval --evidence 'committed d1 on main myself'
for w in w2; do rev=$(mu agent close $w -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$rev" ] && mu agent close $w -w eval --if "$rev"; done

text: d1 is done on main and d2 is merged; both tasks are closed.
